say:1:1430224201:1.text: Half the court's nobles buy their flowers from me.
say:1:1430224201:1.source_cn: 王城里不少的贵族都喜欢从这里买花。
say:1:1430224201:1.male: Half the court's nobles buy their flowers from me.
say:1:1430224201:1.female: Half the court's nobles buy their flowers from me.

say:2:1430224202:1.text: They sometimes have their servants camp outside in line to purchase my wares.
say:2:1430224202:1.source_cn: 他们为了能买到珍稀的花，甚至会让他们的仆从提前来排队。
say:2:1430224202:1.male: They sometimes have their servants camp outside in line to purchase my wares.
say:2:1430224202:1.female: They sometimes have their servants camp outside in line to purchase my wares.
